cues.text: Then Samuel rose up and went to Ramah.
And David went back to his father's sheep. The oil was still in his hair. Nothing had changed, and nothing would be the same.
But there was already a king in Israel. And the LORD's Spirit departed from Saul, and an evil spirit from the LORD troubled him.
The king's servants went looking for a man who could play the lyre. One of them had seen a son of Jesse, the Bethlehemite.
